regulatory_disclosures.sebi_reg30_draft:
DISCLOSURE UNDER REGULATION 30 OF SEBI (LISTING OBLIGATIONS AND DISCLOSURE REQUIREMENTS) REGULATIONS, 2015
To: BSE Limited & National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE)
Subject: Clarification on Fictitious and Malicious Social Media Claims regarding Tata Motors Limited (TATAMOTORS.NS)

We categorically place on record that the allegations and purported regulatory circulars circulating on social channels and trading forums alleging 'URGENT: SEBI issued show cause notice to Tata Motors over Curvv EV battery recalls...' are completely fraudulent, baseless, and maliciously manufactured with deliberate intent to manipulate market sentiment.

The Company maintains full operational stability, robust financial health, and continuous compliance with all statutory guidelines. A formal complaint has been lodged with the Cyber Crime Cell and SEBI Surveillance Division under SEBI (Prohibition of Fraudulent and Unfair Trade Practices) Regulations.
regulatory_disclosures.nse_bse_press_advisory:
OFFICIAL PRESS RELEASE — IMMEDIATE BROADCAST
Mumbai, India — 08 October 2026

Tata Motors Limited urges investors and market participants to disregard unauthorized digital rumors circulating on private messaging networks. The Company confirms zero disruptions across all production facilities, operations, and regulatory licenses. Trading desks are advised to rely strictly on verified exchange disclosures at nseindia.com and bseindia.com.
